title: Bedrock under an assumed role: no stored credential
lede: An LLM key can reach Amazon Bedrock under an assumed IAM role with no provider credential stored on the key, and with metering, AI Guard and audit intact; it also works as a fallback target (release notes). Google Vertex AI as the gateway’s own service account is the sibling feature and is not drawn. The role, trust policy, external ID and short-lived credentials are the lab’s own model.

nodes.label: LLM key
sub: No provider credential stored on the key

nodes.label: Gateway
sub: Reaches Bedrock under an assumed IAM role (release notes)

nodes.label: Customer IAM role
sub: Trust policy and external ID: lab model
Who may assume it: lab model

nodes.label: Amazon Bedrock
sub: The model call runs under the assumed role (release notes)
Also works as a fallback target (release notes)

steps.title: The key holds no credential
steps.what: The call arrives with an LLM key that stores no provider credential (release notes).

steps.title: Assume the customer’s role
steps.what: The gateway assumes an IAM role to reach Bedrock. In the lab model the role’s trust policy has to name the gateway, and an external ID can be required.
steps.why: Lab model. UNVERIFIED: the console fields, the session length and the error text. Failures the lab shows, each with its own named result: wrong trust principal, external ID mismatch, missing invoke permission, model not enabled in the region, expired session.

steps.title: Short-lived credentials
steps.what: In the lab model the role hands short-lived credentials back to the gateway, used for this call and refreshed when they expire.
steps.why: Session length and refresh are lab model and UNVERIFIED.

steps.title: Call Bedrock
steps.what: The gateway makes the model call on Amazon Bedrock under the assumed role and the answer comes back through the gateway (release notes: the same route also works as a fallback target).
steps.why: The gateway, not the role, makes the call (lab model).

steps.title: Metering, AI Guard and audit
steps.what: The same call is metered, passes through AI Guard and is written to audit.
steps.why: Release notes: metering, AI Guard and audit intact.
